profile.headline: PharmD-musician-dancer → Pinterest Apprentice → Full-Stack SWE at Pinterest 📌
profile.summary:
PharmD-turned-SWE, bootcamp graduate with 1.5 yrs experience building full-stack projects in JavaScript & Ruby.

I am passionate about service, self-growth, collaboration, & debugging. I use my curiosity & empathy to design products from scratch centered on the customer’s needs & perspective. I look forward to building platform or infrastructure tools that will help my fellow engineers work with more ease & efficiency, because I have experienced firsthand how good people need good technology to do good work. I am looking to work for a company who can amplify my efforts in serving a mission of positive social impact.

- - - - - 
While I loved working face-to-face with patients as a pharmacist & pharmacy manager, the COVID-19 pandemic combined my pervasive desire to serve a mission greater than myself with toxic work conditions (eg. 16-hour workdays). I resigned in June 2021, promising to myself I would find a way to help others without having to sacrifice my health.

In this next chapter, I am turning my focus inward towards the parts of me that have always loved to stay curious, learn, create, experiment, and collaborate with others. Since graduating App Academy's full-stack software engineering program in September 2022, I have enjoyed creating full-stack apps that I would use myself (eg. as a writer & music-lover). However, I am now looking for opportunities where I can use this growing skillset to support other professionals, whether it is by helping them do their job more easily or by directly building the tools they will use. What drives me today is the core sentiment behind Simon Sinek's quote: "Serve those who serve others."

Working on the frontlines of the pandemic solidified my adaptability, problem-solving, and desire for constant growth & improvement. I am looking to join a team that values mentorship & symbiosis, because I learn quickly given the right support and I have a central motivation to be helpful to others.

When I am not coding, I am digesting podcasts on mental health & somatic healing 🌱 or out dancing 💃🏻 or doing yoga 🧘‍♀️ (if I have time!)~

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Technologies: Square API, Google’s Vertex AI PaLM API, Next.js/Vercel, Supabase
• Systematically designed a product for Devpost Hackathon by researching the Square vendor perspective
• Used React Server components & layout pages so SSR could allow for snappier initial load time & decreased perceived latency for the user through modular data fetching / caching
• Utilized TailwindCSS for ease of reusable utility classes & for a time-efficient clean UX using dashboard UI library Tremor
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · JavaScript · React.js · Product Development · Authentication Protocols · Front-End Development · Code Review · Product Design · User Experience (UX) · Software Development · Teamwork

positions.title: Career transition
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
I took this time to recover from mental & physical burnout after working throughout the peak of the pandemic & the mass administrations of the COVID-19 vaccines. I traveled to 3 countries with my parents. I also worked as an assistant dance teacher and won a couple of dance competitions (local & abroad), while I used coaching & therapy to help me determine where I wanted to go after deciding to quit healthcare.

With some deep self-reflection into my childhood interests, I decided to give App Academy's "ground-zero" pre-bootcamp a shot in April 2022 and never looked back.

positions.title: Pharmacy Manager
positions.locationName: Bronx, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Led pharmacy system conversion from Rite Aid to Walgreens in July 2019 (my second time doing so as an RXM)
• Became sole immunizer for additional 30 to 70 COVID vaccine in-person appointments daily
• Created pharmacy team workflow for administering COVID shots; trained technicians in vaccine product facts & patient eligibility; reconstituted, drew up, & administered vaccines; managed vaccine storage & inventory replenishment
• Directly hired, trained, and managed a team of 4-5 pharmacy technicians & 1 staff pharmacist
• Regulated ordering of Amerisource Bergen inventory & dispensing controlled medications
• Dispelled misinformation about the pandemic and the COVID-19 vaccines on storefront, personal, & social media levels; translated scientific studies for the general public (patients & social media), friends, & family

positions.title: COVID-19 Vaccine Immunizer
positions.description: Once the Pfizer vaccine was approved, I asked my district manager to use me in the vaccination movement against the pandemic because she knew I was passionate about this mission. I participated in the first immunization teams going out to the long-term care facilities (LTCFs) in order to vaccinate those patients and their healthcare providers against COVID-19. Our first site was Parker Jewish Institute at LIJ. Instead of being in my Bronx store, I went to 3 to 4 different LTCFs in Brooklyn & Queens every week, often returning weeks later to administer the second doses as well. I was also instrumental in the Bronx during multiple COVID-19 vaccine emergencies and was pulled a handful of times from my store in order to run emergency in-store clinics for vaccine products that were about to expire.

positions.title: Pharmacy Manager
positions.description:
• Began as graduate pharmacist in September 2017; promoted to RXM in December 2017
• Led pharmacy system conversion from Rite Aid to Walgreens in February 2018 when our location was bought; Walgreens closed our location in September 2018 due to being in close proximity to a legacy Walgreens
• Directly trained and managed 2 pharmacy technicians & 1 staff pharmacist
• Regulated ordering of Amerisource Bergen inventory & controlled medications

positions.title: Music Director for Student Mass
positions.description: • Arranged music for & directed band of 5-8 musicians +/- singers through weekly practice & accompaniment of Catholic Mass
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Creativity and Innovation · Interpersonal Communication · Musical Improvisation

projects.title: Versify
projects.description:
A full-stack clone of the Spotify web app but with a darker & starry undertone and a focus on R&B and Afropop genres. (Note: All music is for non-commercial use as this is a private project.)
• Technologies: React, Redux, Ruby on Rails, PostgresQL
• Used join tables for many-to-many relationships between models to increase database efficiency & maintainability
• Utilized dispatch function to granularly replace slices of the store while persisting state throughout multiple views
• React Router’s match & location objects for browser history within a single page & for responsive UX design
• Integrated Amazon S3 for scalable & cost-efficient image/audio file storage with regional low latency
